2610.10118.title: YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory
2610.10118.paper_summary: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.
2610.10118.paper_summary_zh: 長期推理需要以可管理的生成成本訪問早期信息。全歷史注意力會產生不斷增加的存儲和計算需求，而循環壓縮可能會失去精確的細節。因此，我們提出了 YANchor-4B，一種通用的循環模型，能夠在隨後的推理過程中將關鍵記憶保留為 ANchors 以供檢索。除了 $O(N)$ 時間生成和 $O(1)$ 記憶外，YANchor 通過其多維記憶機制實現了有效的長期推理。例如，在具有挑戰性的數學問題上，它在 AIME 2024--2026 上達到了 82.93% 的平均 pass@1，並在 HMMT 上達到了 63.64%，顯著超越了線性時間、常數狀態的對應模型，包括更大的模型。它還在 H100 上提供了比 Transformer 和混合基準高幾倍的批量長生成吞吐量。此外，對數十個基準的評估顯示了 YANchor 在通用能力方面的優越性。
